description: This file defines the GaugeBasicConfigComponent class, which manages configuration settings for an analog gauge widget in a dashboard application. It includes form setup, validation, and methods for handling widget configuration data.

classes.name: GaugeBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Component class for configuring an analog gauge widget, including form initialization, validation, and configuration output handling.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the configuration data from the form.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets widget config options based on selected card buttons.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for the gauge value.

methods.name: _unitsPreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for the gauge units.
